sourceRule: {"id": "rule-700", "name": "Confirmed malware execution on production VM", "description": "Wiz Sensor detected a known malware signature executing on a production virtual machine.", "resolutionRecommendation": "Isolate the VM, run a full malware scan, and rotate any credentials the workload had access to.", "sourceType": "THREAT_INTEL"}

{"id": "rule-701", "name": "Publicly exposed container with data exfiltration path to the internet", "description": "A toxic combination correlating a publicly exposed container with an attached role that can read sensitive storage.", "resolutionRecommendation": "Remove public network exposure and scope down the attached role.", "sourceType": "TOXIC_COMBINATION_RULE"}

{"id": "rule-702", "name": "Publicly exposed storage bucket combined with excessive IAM permissions", "description": "A toxic combination correlating a publicly readable bucket with an over-permissioned IAM role attached.", "resolutionRecommendation": "Restrict bucket ACLs to private and scope down the attached IAM role.", "sourceType": "TOXIC_COMBINATION_RULE"}

{"id": "rule-703", "name": "MFA not enforced for privileged user account", "description": "This rule flags privileged user accounts that do not have multi-factor authentication enforced.", "resolutionRecommendation": "Enable and enforce MFA for the affected account.", "sourceType": "CONFIGURATION_RULE"}

sourceRule: {"id": "rule-704", "name": "Service account has unused excessive permissions", "description": "This rule flags service accounts with IAM permissions that have not been used in the last 90 days.", "resolutionRecommendation": "Remove unused permissions to enforce least privilege.", "sourceType": "CONFIGURATION_RULE"}

{"id": "rule-705", "name": "Database server allows unencrypted connections", "description": "This rule checks whether the database server enforces TLS for client connections.", "resolutionRecommendation": "Enforce TLS-only connections on the database server.", "sourceType": "CONFIGURATION_RULE"}

{"id": "rule-706", "name": "Confirmed ransomware behavior detected on compute instance", "description": "Wiz correlated file encryption activity consistent with known ransomware behavior on a compute instance.", "resolutionRecommendation": "Isolate the instance immediately, restore from clean backups, and rotate credentials.", "sourceType": "THREAT_INTEL"}
